text:
This is a really tricky challenge! Can you make your own protractor, using just paper, a pencil and scissors?

Start off by cutting a semi-circle. Then work out where 90 degrees should go. Now by folding another piece of paper, or using objects around your house, can you find exactly where 45, 30 and 60 degrees should go?

When you have finished, check your protractor against a real protractor. Did you get the angles in the right place?
